tools.name: lodgify_list_properties

params.description: Optional query parameters for filtering and pagination (e.g., limit, offset, status)

tools.name: lodgify_get_property

id.description: Unique identifier of the property to retrieve

tools.name: lodgify_list_property_rooms
tools.description: Retrieve all room types and configurations for a specific property. Returns room details including capacity, pricing structure, amenities, and booking rules. Use this before checking availability or making bookings to understand available accommodation options.

propertyId.description: Property ID to list room types for

tools.name: lodgify_list_bookings

params.description: Optional query parameters for filtering (date range, status, property ID, guest details, etc.)

tools.name: lodgify_get_booking
tools.description: Retrieve complete details for a specific booking including guest information, property details, room assignments, pricing breakdown, payment status, special requests, and booking timeline. Use this for customer service inquiries and detailed booking management.

tools.name: lodgify_find_properties

searchTerm.description: Optional search term to filter properties by name (case-insensitive)

includePropertyIds.description: Include property IDs found in recent bookings (default: true)

limit.description: Maximum number of properties to return (default: 10)

tools.name: lodgify_delete_booking
tools.description: Permanently cancel and delete a booking from the system. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. Use with extreme caution and ensure proper authorization. Consider using booking modification instead of deletion when possible.

id.description: Booking ID to cancel and delete permanently

tools.name: lodgify_list_deleted_properties
tools.description: Retrieve properties that have been soft-deleted from the system. Useful for auditing, recovery operations, and understanding property lifecycle. Returns properties that were previously active but have been removed from general availability.

params.description: Optional query parameters for filtering deleted properties

tools.name: lodgify_daily_rates
tools.description: Retrieve daily pricing calendar for properties showing rates across date ranges. Essential for pricing analysis, revenue optimization, and understanding seasonal rate variations. Returns detailed rate information including base rates, modifiers, and availability-based pricing.

params.description: Required: propertyId, from/to dates (YYYY-MM-DD format). Optional: roomTypeId, currency

tools.name: lodgify_rate_settings
tools.description: Retrieve rate configuration settings including pricing rules, modifiers, seasonal adjustments, and rate calculation parameters. Essential for understanding how rates are calculated and configuring pricing strategies.

params.description: Query parameters for rate settings (propertyId, currency, etc.)

tools.name: lodgify_create_rate
tools.description: Create or update pricing rates for specific properties and room types over date ranges. Use this to set seasonal pricing, special event rates, or update base pricing. Rates can be set for specific date ranges and room types.

roomTypeId.description: Room type to set rates for

payload.description: Rate details including property, room type, dates, and rate amount

tools.name: lodgify_update_rate
tools.description: Modify an existing rate entry with new pricing, dates, or currency. Use this to adjust previously set rates, extend date ranges, or update pricing for specific rate periods. Requires the rate ID from previous rate operations.

payload.description: Updated rate details - only provided fields will be changed

tools.name: lodgify_get_booking_payment_link
tools.description: Retrieve existing payment link for a booking including payment status, amount due, and link expiration. Use this to check if a payment link already exists or to get current payment details for customer service inquiries.

id.description: Booking ID to get payment link for

tools.name: lodgify_create_booking_payment_link
tools.description: Generate a secure payment link for a booking allowing guests to pay outstanding balances online. Useful for collecting deposits, final payments, or additional charges. The link will be sent to guests via email or can be shared directly.

id.description: Booking ID to create payment link for

payload.description: Payment link configuration - amount, currency, and description

tools.name: lodgify_update_key_codes
tools.description: Update access key codes for a booking to provide guests with property entry information. Used for smart locks, keypad codes, or other access control systems. Essential for self-check-in processes and property access management.

id.description: Booking ID to update key codes for

keyCodes.description: Array of access codes/keys for the property

payload.description: Access key codes and entry information

tools.name: lodgify_create_booking
tools.description: Create a new booking/reservation in the system. This will check availability, calculate pricing, and create a confirmed reservation. Ensure availability is checked first using availability tools before creating bookings to avoid conflicts.

roomTypes.description: Room types and quantities to book

payload.description: Complete booking details - property, dates, guests, and rooms

tools.name: lodgify_update_booking
tools.description: Modify an existing booking including dates, guest count, status, or other booking details. Use this for handling booking modifications, extensions, guest count changes, or status updates. Availability will be rechecked for date changes.

payload.description: Updated booking details - only provided fields will be changed

tools.name: lodgify_availability_room
tools.description:
⚠️ **DEPRECATED** (since v0.1.1): Raw availability data is complex. Use availability helper tools for better results Please use 'lodgify_check_next_availability, lodgify_get_availability_calendar' instead. This tool will be removed in v1.0.0.

Get raw availability data for a specific room type (GET /v2/availability/{propertyId}/{roomTypeId}). Note: This returns technical availability data. For easier availability checking, use lodgify_check_next_availability or lodgify_get_availability_calendar instead.

params.description: Optional query parameters including from/to dates (YYYY-MM-DD format)

tools.name: lodgify_availability_property
tools.description:
⚠️ **DEPRECATED** (since v0.1.1): Raw availability data is complex. Use availability helper tools for better results Please use 'lodgify_check_next_availability, lodgify_get_availability_calendar' instead. This tool will be removed in v1.0.0.

Get raw availability data for a property (GET /v2/availability/{propertyId}). Note: This returns technical availability data. For easier availability checking, use lodgify_check_next_availability or lodgify_get_availability_calendar instead.

params.description: Optional query parameters including from/to dates (YYYY-MM-DD format)

tools.name: lodgify_check_next_availability
tools.description:
[Availability & Calendar] Find the next available date for a property by analyzing bookings. Returns when the property is next available and for how long. If property ID is unknown, use lodgify_find_properties first.

Example request:
{
  "propertyId": "123",
  "fromDate": "2024-03-15",
  "daysToCheck": 90
}

Example response:
{
  "propertyId": 123,
  "nextAvailableDate": "2024-03-22",
  "availableDays": 7,
  "availableUntil": "2024-03-29",
  "message": "Next available from 2024-03-22 for 7 days",
  "recommendations": [
    "Check availability calendar for detailed daily status",
    "Consider checking different room types if property is fully booked"
  ]
}

fromDate.description: Start date to check from (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today if not provided.

daysToCheck.description: Number of days to check ahead (1-365). Defaults to 90 days.

tools.name: lodgify_check_date_range_availability
tools.description: Verify if a specific date range is available for booking at a property. Returns detailed availability status including any conflicts or restrictions. Use this before creating bookings to ensure availability and avoid booking conflicts.

propertyId.description: Property ID to check availability for

tools.name: lodgify_get_availability_calendar
tools.description: Retrieve a visual calendar view of property availability showing available, booked, and blocked dates. Perfect for displaying availability to guests, planning maintenance windows, or understanding booking patterns over time.

propertyId.description: Property ID to get calendar for

fromDate.description: Calendar start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today

daysToShow.description: Number of days to display (1-90). Default: 30 days

tools.name: lodgify_get_quote
tools.description: Calculate detailed pricing quote for a property booking including room rates, taxes, fees, and total cost. Essential for providing accurate pricing to guests before booking confirmation. Supports complex parameters for multiple room types and add-ons.

params.description: Quote parameters: dates (from/to), room types (roomTypes[0].Id), guest breakdown (guest_breakdown[adults]), add-ons. Uses bracket notation for complex parameters.

tools.name: lodgify_get_thread
tools.description: Retrieve a messaging conversation thread including all messages, participants, and thread metadata. Use this for customer service inquiries, guest communication history, or managing ongoing conversations with guests and staff.

threadGuid.description: Unique thread identifier (GUID) for the conversation

tools.name: lodgify_update_property_availability
tools.description: Modify property availability settings including blocking/opening dates, minimum stay requirements, and maximum stay limits. Use this to set maintenance periods, seasonal restrictions, or special booking rules for specific date ranges.

propertyId.description: Property ID to update availability for

available.description: Whether property is available for booking in this period

payload.description: Availability update configuration including dates, availability status, and stay restrictions

tools.name: lodgify_subscribe_webhook
tools.description: Set up webhook subscriptions to receive real-time notifications for booking events, property changes, and other system updates. Essential for integrating external systems and automating workflows based on Lodgify events.

event.description: Event type to subscribe to (e.g., booking.created, booking.updated)

targetUrl.description: HTTPS URL endpoint to receive webhook notifications

payload.description: Webhook subscription configuration - event type and notification endpoint

tools.name: lodgify_list_webhooks
tools.description: Retrieve all active webhook subscriptions including event types, target URLs, and subscription status. Use this to audit existing integrations, troubleshoot webhook delivery issues, or manage webhook configurations.

params.description: Optional query parameters for filtering webhooks by status, event type, etc.

tools.name: lodgify_delete_webhook
tools.description: Permanently remove a webhook subscription and stop receiving event notifications. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. Use this to clean up unused integrations or when changing webhook configurations.
